ns2:course.label: Graduate Level Double Bass
ns2:course.description: Study at the graduate level in double bass; selected studies from the masterworks in double bass literature. Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the String faculty. May be repeated to a maximum of 20 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the String faculty; concurrent registration in Symphony Orchestra for students in the Master of Music curriculum in strings.
